_about: MASTER_LAB01 door controller enclosure - every dimension in mm. Edit, then run build.ps1 to regenerate all parts in SOLIDWORKS. Confidence labels (2026-10-20 research, reports/Door enclosure component dimensions.md): DATASHEET = manufacturer drawing for the exact part; VARIANT = drawing of the matching board variant; REFERENCE = similar part / other seller; CHOSEN = design choice; MEASURE = check with calipers or the fit coupon before the full print. No speaker / PAM8403 (removed by the owner 2026-10-20).

envelope._status: CHOSEN: fits a 220 x 220 bed printed back-down; interference check in out/interference.txt; 45 mm wire space between the plate modules (top z 40) and the front modules (bottom z 85); depth 90 -> 110 on 2026-10-20 (owner: more room for wires).

print._status: CHOSEN: FDM sliding fit 0.2-0.3 (Xometry); general tolerance +-0.3

fasteners._insert_status: DATASHEET (CNC Kitchen M3 x 5.7 x 4.6: hole 4.0, min wall 1.6, blind hole +1 mm). Most Electronics' M3 insert has no published size: MEASURE it; the coupon has 3.9 / 4.0 / 4.2 test holes.
fasteners._pilot_status: CHOSEN pilot for M2.5 self-tapping (PT/KA) screws into PLA/PETG; coupon has 2.0 / 2.2 / 2.4

front_panel.title: DOOR NODE  (MASTER ESP)
front_panel._label_status: CHOSEN engraved 0.6 deep, >= 5 mm high (engraved strokes >= 1.0 mm survive a 0.4 nozzle; Hubs/JLC guides). Panel printed FRONT-DOWN: the bed gives the smoothest face and engraved text stays crisp; raised text front-down is impossible and front-up shows layer lines. The coupon prints both at 5 and 7 mm to confirm.

tft._ref: VARIANT: Most ME-38699 red '1.8 TFT SPI 128*160 V1.1' = LCDWIKI MSP1803: PCB 34.5 x 58, 4 holes D3.2 on 28.5 x 52 (3.0 from the edges). DATASHEET (QDTFT1801 panel): glass 34.7 x 46.7 x 2.4 (+-0.2/+-0.1), active area 28.03 x 35.04, 3.00 from the glass edge opposite the ribbon (8.66 at the ribbon end). Glass position on the PCB NOT dimensioned (~6.0 / 5.2 from the PCB ends, scaled).
tft._window_status: CHOSEN 30 x 40: active area 28.03 x 35.04 + 1 mm sides, +2.5 mm each end to cover the undimensioned glass position and ribbon end; stays inside the 46.7 glass (black glass border shows as a bezel)
tft._boss_status: bosses at the 4 PCB holes, as tall as the glass (2.4) so the glass touches the panel; D4.2 keeps 0.2 from the glass edge; 4 x M2.5 x 6 self-tapping screws

nfc._ref: VARIANT: Ekostra EK506 'PN532 NFC RFID Module V3' (red), Elechouse 42.7 x 40.4 x 4. REFERENCE (Elechouse V4 STEP, 'same shape, same mounting holes as V3'): 2 holes D3.05 at (7.39, 7.59) and (35.19, 32.79) from the top-left corner = +-13.9 / +-12.6 about the centre; red clones 43 x 40 'holes 3 mm'.
nfc._pocket_status: 43 x 40.4 largest listed outline + 0.6/1.0; skin 1.5 (antenna 4 mm from the card incl. the 2.5 air gap; read range 50-60 mm free air, DATASHEET). VERIFY a card reads through the coupon first.
nfc._island_status: 4 islands (both diagonals) so the board fits either way round; the board rests on them at the rear plane, held by 2 x M2.5 x 5 self-tapping screws. REFERENCE hole positions: MEASURE on the coupon.

fingerprint._ref: DATASHEET (GROW R307 manual v1.20 p.2) for Most ME-30297: body 44.1 x 20 x 23.5, no flange / ears, sensing window 15 x 11.19, 'window dimension 19 x 21' (prism head face), side notches 1.5 deep 22.9 from the sensor end, connector 3.2 below the base. Tolerances not published.
fingerprint._aperture_status: head face 21 (along) x 19 (across) + 0.4, starting at the sensor end; coupon has 21.0/21.4/21.8 x 19.0/19.4/19.8 and a full cradle to try the real module. If the module measures ~52 long it is an R307S body: change body_l / pocket_l.

leds._ref: REFERENCE Kingbright L-53 5 mm: body D5.0, flange D5.9 x 1.0, length 8.6 (+-0.25); Most LEDs unbranded with a flange
leds._status: 5.1 hole: the 5.9 flange stops the LED from behind, dome stands ~3.6 proud; coupon 5.0/5.1/5.2/5.3

buzzer._ref: VARIANT: Most 5 V ME-32997 / 12 V ME-19495 active buzzer D12 x 9.5, 85 dB, 2.3 kHz ('HXD'); DATASHEET TMB12A05 D12.0 +-0.2 x 9.5 +-0.2, pins 7.6 apart

glands._ref: DATASHEET panel holes: PG7 12.5-12.8 (cable 3-6.5), M16x1.5 16.0-16.3 (cable 4-8). Most Electronics sells no glands: buy PG7 x 3 + M16 x 1 with locknuts (electrical supplier). Plain holes + locknut, no printed thread (3 mm wall << 8 mm thread).

usb_access._ref: VARIANT: Most ESP32 30-pin CH340 USB-C 51.5 x 28.5; USB-C on the short edge. Height of the connector = plate top 13 + breadboard 8.5-10 + header 2.5 + PCB 1.6 + half the receptacle 1.6 = 27.2-28.7
usb_access._status: CHOSEN 14 x 12 passes USB-C overmolds up to 13 x 8 with the height uncertainty; ESP32 end 12 mm from the wall

vents._status: CHOSEN: both side walls, at the buck converter (top left)

keyholes._status: REFERENCE keyhole designs for 4 mm screws: entry 9-10, slot 4.6-5.0, 10-12 long

electronics_plate._slot_status: no module hole pattern is published for Most's parts, so M3 / cable-tie slots everywhere; labels engraved inside each module's footprint
